WHAT SHIPPED (src/managent/main.zig + build.zig + tools/regression-run-record-scale.sh):
(1) readRunRecords is bounded by the in-progress set. It takes the live tids, reproduces
tools/runner's _sanitize_identity filename mangling, and only opens <tid>.json or <tid>.<N>.json
for a live row. classifyReapRows collects the in-progress tids first, so reap AND resume inherit
the bound. Opt-in diagnostic MANAGENT_RUN_RECORD_OPENS=1 emits 'run-records: opened N of M .json
entries for K in-progress row(s)'.
(2) New `managent archive-runs [--dry-run] [--date] [--min-age-days d]` (named archive-runs, NOT
archive, which is the kanban retire command). COLD = task not in_progress + pid dead per the
process table (a done row with a live worker — T909 — is never archived) + older than
--min-age-days (default 2, so AC7's 24h wall-kill window and recent forensics are never hidden).
Cold records move into untracked/runs/archive-<date>/ via renamePreserve (atomic, non-replacing).
Archive, never delete; idempotent; a re-dispatch writes a fresh bare record so the bare record
stays findable.
